name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova attachment, fixed: an opt-in filled variant for a pasted-text chip, with a muted fill, no border, a 44px height, 8px corners and a regular-weight title; the container focus ring appears on keyboard focus only. Depends on the fixed button so installing it preserves that fix. The tile variant is a 64px square image tile with a covering image, rounded-lg corners and a subtle border; corner actions show on hover or focus and always on touch or error, the name stays available to screen readers, and tiles snap in a scrolling group. Running titles pause while out of view with use-shimmer-pause. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
